summary: Authored a six-phase plan pinning the three advisory repo-health signals to committed keyed ratchet baselines with gates that fail on an increase. Two planning decisions are recorded in the plan rather than deferred: the C16 baseline is a new keyed file instead of an extension of scripts/nolints.json, and a README baseline row pins the stamped date rather than only the path.
